audit.report: Checkout degraded to 0-68% success (vs 95% SLO) because the batch_replayable_review_sentiment_index job (pid 1312056) held locks while idle in transaction on batch 14 of 40. The Database Guardian proposed terminating the blocker, citing $18,400/min revenue at risk with 60s tolerance already exceeded, an 18-minute replay cost for the BATCH_REPLAYABLE workload, and 4/4 historical successes from similar terminations. The Continuity Guardian accepted immediately. Termination executed in one round; verification confirmed 100% checkout success (35/35) with no lock waits and all protected operations intact. The business is fully recovered.
audit.root_cause: The batch_replayable_review_sentiment_index job (pid 1312056) held locks while idle in transaction for 5+ seconds, blocking checkout sessions and driving success rate to 0%.
lessons: For review_sentiment_index workload: Add a statement_timeout to batch_worker role to prevent idle-in-transaction from holding locks beyond a safe threshold (the job was idle 5s on batch 14/40 with chunk size 5k rows per DATA-4471).

For review_sentiment_index workload: Enforce the replica lag guardrail mentioned in the code comment (revert if replica lag > 30s) via automated monitoring to catch chunk-size-induced lock contention earlier.

For review_sentiment_index workload: Document the 18-minute replay procedure and may_interrupt policy in the incident runbook so future negotiations skip the biz.workload_registry and biz.impact probes.
audit.negotiation_critique: The Database Guardian proposed termination in round 1 with complete evidence (lock holder, workload class, replay cost, change calendar, protected settlements, trade-off math, and 4/4 memory precedents); the Continuity Guardian accepted with no objections, making this a clean single-round negotiation with no wasted rounds or missed evidence.
follow_ups: Add statement_timeout to the batch_worker database role to auto-abort idle-in-transaction sessions.
Implement automated replica lag alerting for the review_sentiment_index job tied to the DATA-4471 chunk size change.
Create a runbook entry for review_sentiment_index with the 18-minute replay steps and may_interrupt confirmation.
